thread:
elaine-recruits: Heads up — during the panel reassign job this morning a subset of candidates lost their panel_owner field in ATS. Not sending invites but scheduler is treating some as unassigned and spamming reschedule prompts.

matt-ops: Ugh. Any idea which deploy or job triggered it?

elaine-recruits: Looks like the new 'panel-owner' migration script (deploy @ 08:02) that adds a nullable owner_id ran against the live backfill instead of the staging snapshot. I have a failing SQL snippet:
```
UPDATE panels SET owner_id = NULL WHERE external_id LIKE 'pilot-%' AND updated_at > '2026-03-23T08:00:00Z';
```
Seems the WHERE clause was inverted in one iteration.

devon-platform: I saw increased error noise from ats-sync-bot around 08:05. Bot logs show a retry storm for assignments. Pasting excerpt:
```
[08:05:12] ats-sync-bot WARN  assignment-worker: missing owner_id for panel 98432 -> enqueue fallback
[08:06:01] assignment-worker INFO  enqueue candidate 6712 to manual-review
```

rachel-people: Practically — some interviewers got duplicate invites, others saw 'unassigned interviewer' in prep packs. Candidates reported 2 calendar invites. We should stop the backfill ASAP.

matt-ops: Rolling back the migration script right away. devon — can you flip the feature flag and pause the assignment-workers queue?

devon-platform: Flipping flag now: `feature.panel_owner_backfill=false`.
Queue paused: assignment-workers drained, new tasks rejected.

ats-sync-bot: automated message: assignment queue paused by devon-platform at 08:12 UTC. 142 tasks in-flight.

elaine-recruits: Thanks — please don't run the backfill again. For immediate fix, can we backfill correct owner_id from the audit_events table (pre-migration snapshot) and run a targeted reassign for affected candidate ids? I have a list of 27 candidate ids.

matt-ops: Yes. Plan: 1) restore owner_id for those 27 from audit_events (read-only), 2) run `reassign-if-missing --candidates <list>` in dry-run, 3) run for real, 4) unpause queue. Devon, can you allocate a small window for this? Preferably 08:30–08:45.

devon-platform: I can do 08:30. Will take a DB backup before patch.

rachel-people: Also need comms: tell affected interviewers and candidates to ignore duplicate invites and that we will confirm the single canonical invite after fix. I'll draft a short note.

elaine-recruits: Draft looks good. Two asks for engineering: include an idempotency token on the reassign job and add a safety gate to the migration script to disallow running against production without `--force` and a confirm prompt.

matt-ops: Agreed. I'll open a PR for the migration safety gate and an incident ticket for the backfill rollback and recovery run.

elaine-recruits: Posting candidate ids in #private-ops — please use them only for the remediation. I'll monitor candidate outreach.

rachel-people: I'll send the candidate-facing note and interviewer heads-up once we confirm the reassign completed.

matt-ops: Reassign dry-run scheduled 08:32, actual run 08:34 after DB snapshot complete. I'll update thread when done.

ats-sync-bot: automated message: DB snapshot completed at 08:31 UTC.

matt-ops: Dry-run output: 27 candidates would be re-assigned, no conflicts. Proceeding with actual run now.

ats-sync-bot: automated message: reassign job finished at 08:35 UTC — 27 reassignments applied. No errors.

devon-platform: Unpausing queues; monitoring for duplicates.

elaine-recruits: Confirmed with two sample candidates — prep pack now shows correct interviewer and single calendar invite. Closing loop.

rachel-people: Comms sent to interviewers/candidates. FYI raised to engineering for migration safety changes.

matt-ops: Incident ticket created: I-2642. PR for migration safety gate: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/2209

elaine-recruits: Thanks everyone. Postmortem planned for tomorrow 10:00 AM to cover safeguards and testing for migrations that touch ATS.
